MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 30
   C. 15
   D. 44

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 19
   C. 30
   D. 38

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

5. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23

6. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

7. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

8. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

9. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

10. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 100
   B. 11
   C. 50
   D. 10

11. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
